import json
v = json.load(open('.gitreins/history/2026-11-22/ba885d3c/verdict.json'))
print('task_id:', v.get('task_id'))
print('passed:', v.get('passed'))
print('pass_class:', v.get('pass_class'))
print('commit:', v.get('commit'))
print('tier2_skipped:', v.get('tier2_skipped'))
st = v.get('stages',{})
t1 = st.get('tier1',{})
print('tier1 passed:', t1.get('passed'))
for s in t1.get('steps',[]):
    print('  tier1 step:', s.get('id'), 'passed:', s.get('passed'), '| out head:', (s.get('output') or '')[:150].replace(chr(10),' '))
t2 = st.get('tier2',{})
print('tier2 passed:', t2.get('passed'))
for s in t2.get('steps',[]):
    print('  tier2 step:', s.get('id'), 'passed:', s.get('passed'))
crit = v.get('task_criteria')
print('num criteria:', len(crit))
for it in v.get('items',[]):
    if not it.get('derived'):
        print('GIVEN item status:', it.get('status'))
        print('GIVEN detail:', it.get('detail','')[:1500])
"
